- `npm run build:zoom-embed` → 1 file, 3.8MB, exit 0, no CSS sidecar

Done — meetings now start on the slot window, not the whole day. Your example: 10:30 + 30 min → startable 10:30–11:00, so 10:42 starts.

**Changed** (`frontend/src/components/modules/ApplicantManagement.tsx`, build exit 0, nothing committed):
- New `getInterviewWindow(date, time, duration, now)` → `future-day` / `upcoming` / `live` / `ended` / `past-day`. Parses `10:30 AM`, `10:30`, `10:30:00`; duration from `slotSettings.intervalMinutes` (the Slot duration dropdown: 15/20/30/45/60).
- Applicant view panel: Start buttons only when `live`; today-before-slot shows `Starts at 10:30 AM (30 min)`; ended shows `Interview window has passed`.
- Pipeline table menu: same window drives enable/disable + hover tooltip (`Starts at…` / `Available on interview day` / `Interview window has passed`).
- 15s visible-tab clock added so Start flips on/off without refresh (the 20s record poll already re-renders most of the time).

**Verified logic:** 10:30/30min @10:42 → live; @10:30 → live; @11:00 → ended; @10:29 → upcoming.

Edge case kept safe: unparseable time on today's date falls back to the old allow-start behavior so nothing gets stuck.

messages.text: can you explain how my zoom interview work please explain in simple

content.text:
Here's how your Zoom interview works, simply:

**1. Schedule** — You book a Virtual interview for an applicant (date, time, interviewer). The system creates a real Zoom meeting and emails the applicant the Join link + password.

**2. Wait for the slot** — If the slot is 30 minutes at 10:30, the meeting can start 10:30–11:00. Before that it says "Starts at…", after that "window has passed".

**3. Start** — Click **Start Zoom Interview**. A popup opens with your camera preview, the applicant joins from their emailed link, and you see each other inside your system — no Zoom app needed.

**4. Interview** — Score the applicant on the form beside the video. Live captions run below. When done, save — the score and result are recorded.

The pieces behind it: your Zoom account hosts the meeting, your server makes the meeting + a join signature, and the popup embeds the live video.

messages.summary:
## Objective
Finish a working in-HRMS embedded Zoom interview feature for the Applicant Management module (no Zoom app required) and polish its UI based on user screenshots.

## Requirements
- Meeting must start only inside its slot window (e.g. 10:30 + 30 min → startable 10:30–11:00)
- Video preview must fill its pane; black stage is unacceptable UX
- Final card = chromeless meeting only: no card, no gray header, no border
- User declined replacing the embed (kept Meeting SDK, cameras on)

## Decisions
- Meeting SDK Component View inside a React-free iframe (SDK pins React 18, app is React 19)
- SDK loaded as vendored UMD `<script>`s (not bundled) — Rollup bundling caused dual-React `ReactCurrentOwner` crash
- Interviewer joins with **host role (1)** so the meeting starts on open; applicant waits in waiting room
- Video defaults to `defaultViewType: "speaker"`; gallery available via toolbar View button
- Added dismissible "Cameras are off — turn on video in the meeting toolbar" pill
- Applicant re-apply work: created a new record and deleted prior history (with resume copy first)

## Work State

### Completed
- Backend: Zoom config block, `ZoomMeetingService` (mock + real API + `sdkSignature`/`sdkConfigured`), `POST /api/v1/interviews/{id}/zoom-signature`, route registered, `.env` keys verified (OAuth 200)
- Frontend: `interviewsApi.zoomSignature()`, `ZoomEmbeddedMeeting.tsx` (iframe + postMessage protocol + fallbacks), `zoom-embed.html` (watchdog, vendor loader, camera-state reporting), `scripts/build-zoom-embed.mjs` vendoring, `package.json` `build:zoom-embed` wired into `build`/`build:dev`, `.gitignore` for `public/zoom-sdk/`
- Slot-window gating (`getInterviewWindow`, `parseInterviewTimeToMinutes`, 15s clock) in ApplicantManagement.tsx + detail panel + pipeline menu
- UI: chromeless card, compact one-row links, speaker view, camera-off pill — all verified live via Playwright
- Maricel Dizon re-applied as id 94 / `APL-01097`, email `butchoylangsalakam01@gmail.com`, resume + 6 docs attached, spaCy screening 76%
- All builds green; nothing committed

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Black video stage persists when both cameras are off — no SDK join option for camera-on; pill informs HR
- Interview 64/65 mock-era meetings rejected by Zoom (only fresh Virtual bookings work)

### Blocked (continued)
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Commit/push the uncommitted Zoom + UI work if the user asks (currently all changes sit in the working tree on branch `merging-ground`)
2. Await user feedback on the chromeless card; re-run `npm run build:zoom-embed` if `@zoom/meetingsdk` is upgraded

## Relevant Files
- `frontend/public/zoom-embed.html`: chromeless embed page — React 18 UMDs → SDK UMD, gallery/speaker init, watchdog, camera-state postMessage
- `frontend/src/components/applicants/ZoomEmbeddedMeeting.tsx`: iframe host, signature fetch (role 1), pre-flight HEAD, pill, fallback preview
- `frontend/src/components/modules/ApplicantManagement.tsx`: Zoom room dialog (chromeless card ~line 15848), slot-window helpers, start gating
- `frontend/scripts/build-zoom-embed.mjs`: vendors SDK + React 18 UMDs into `public/zoom-sdk/`
- `backend-laravel/app/Services/ZoomMeetingService.php`: mock/api providers + SDK signature
- `backend-laravel/Modules/ApplicantManagement/app/Http/Controllers/InterviewController.php`: `zoomSignature()` endpoint
- `backend-laravel/config/services.php`: `zoom` config block
- `backend-laravel/.env`: `ZOOM_*` keys all set (never commit)

## Important Context
- Dev URLs: frontend `http://localhost:5173`, Laravel `http://127.0.0.1:8000`; test login `bullseur@oxfordsuites.com.ph` / `Oxford@2026` with dev OTP shown on the OTP page
- Playwright tab click times out on Radix menus — dispatch pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click via `browser_evaluate`; menus often render outside the viewport
- Browser timezone is Asia/Manila; DB is MySQL; test interview id 65 must stay at `11:00:00` (guarded restores use exact-match checks)
- Zoom SDK files are git-ignored in `public/zoom-sdk/`; `dist/` also ignored
- Meeting SDK free; meetings billed to host Zoom plan (Free = 40-min cap)
